title: SparseBitMatrix::matvec prefetch + block-CSR layout
description:
## Current

`SparseBitMatrix::matvec` (`crates/gf2-core/src/sparse.rs`) does scalar CSR iteration. No prefetch, no block layout, gather pattern is index-driven (cache-unfriendly for LDPC parity-check sizes).

## Fix

PPC walk:

- V6 prefetch: software prefetch of `col_idx[i + lookahead]` while processing entry `i`. Tune `lookahead` from L1 latency.
- V7 layout: try block-CSR (4×64 dense bit-blocks within sparse rows). Add a one-shot transformer from CSR → block-CSR.
- V3 SIMD: only inside dense blocks (XOR-reduce a u64 row of 4 packed columns).

## Per-kernel execution protocol

Per A1's protocol. Cache-bound nature means asm artefact must show prefetch instructions actually emitted; perf-stat must show L1d-miss rate drop.

## Depends on

I1, I2, I3, I4.

## Success criteria

- [hard] Bit-exact vs. existing CSR matvec.
- [hard] Block-CSR transformer is a separate function, not silently replacing CSR (callers opt in).
- [hard] L1d-miss rate drops on the LDPC-sized sparse bench (qualitative — exact threshold tuned by reviewer).
- [aspirational] ≥1.5× geomean on `sparse.rs` bench at LDPC parity-check sizes.
